name: accent
title: Accent
description: The accent themes: set and read the person's colour, mark it before the first paint, give one page its own, a picker of the seven and a preview.

meta.whenToUse: A settings page where a person or a workspace picks its colour, the root layout that paints it first, and a public page in its workspace's colour.
meta.whenNotToUse: Colouring data (chart tokens), labels (tags) or status; or an arbitrary brand colour (override the tokens).
